headline: Names a Colorado post office building after Deputy Sheriff Zackari Spurlock Parrish, III.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 9609 South University Boulevard in Highlands Ranch, Colorado. The building will be officially called the "Deputy Sheriff Zackari Spurlock Parrish, III, Post Office Building." It is a naming measure and does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018, and the name took effect at that time.
